message: Your teamspace apollo-edit-web in organization historiasde7dias-org account does not have enough credits to run this request. Please top up to continue or bill another account.
tip:
💡 Tip: Where charges are applied

    • PERSONAL ACCOUNT
      Costs are charged to your own account.
      Example: LIGHTNING_API_KEY → f7...c60

    • PERSONAL TEAMSPACE
      Costs are charged to a teamspace you own.
      Example: LIGHTNING_API_KEY/USERNAME/TEAMSPACE_NAME → f7...c60/my-username/research

    • ORGANIZATION TEAMSPACE
      Costs are charged to a teamspace within an organization.
      Example: LIGHTNING_API_KEY/ORG_NAME/TEAMSPACE_NAME → f7...c60/lit-labs/production-apps

    • ORGANIZATION ACCOUNT
      Costs are charged to the whole organization.
      Example: LIGHTNING_API_KEY/ORG_NAME → f7...c60/lit-labs
